rationale: C24 plausibly supplied a concrete letter template: both Eisenhower letters open by acknowledging a newly received report, immediately characterize its results as “indeed heartening,” explain the report’s broader public significance, and close with an affirmative assessment. C11 has a similar report-receipt and praise structure but less distinctive verbal overlap; C07 shares the report-response setting but not the child’s evaluative development.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I have read with interest your October first report to me... It is indeed heartening to see...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am very glad to have your final report... It is indeed heartening to know...
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive shared transition from acknowledging a report to the phrase “It is indeed heartening,” with only minor adaptation.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Clearly, the experience of the past year under this statute attests to the wisdom of those who worked so diligently...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Certainly the Capital of this great nation deserves to be a symbol of our best efforts...
shared_material.explanation: Both broaden the report’s concrete results into an assessment of their national or public significance.

shared_material.child_excerpt: It is my hope that our working men and women will continue to use the provisions of this law...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I should want the cooperating agencies to know, therefore, that in the furtherance of these plans...
shared_material.explanation: Both conclude the substantive discussion by looking toward continued implementation of the reported program.
